singleSourced.context: For those looking to play on PC, there's even more good news: Fanatical is offering a discount on it right now of 18% off, dropping it down to $57.39 (see it here).
Compared to paying its full price of $69.99, this offer saves you just over $10 on the game, which isn't bad at launch.

singleSourced.value: Each time I landed a perfectly timed Issen, pulled off a risky deflect, or landed a combo at just the right time, I felt like I had accomplished something.
singleSourced.context:
Writer Will Borger's 10/10 review highlighted that, "Each time I landed a perfectly timed Issen, pulled off a risky deflect, or landed a combo at just the right time, I felt like I had accomplished something."

Its rhythmic attack patterns will certainly keep you on your toes, but that's not all.
Borger also writes that it has "an excellent story to match" its action-packed combat, so you'll have plenty of time to be invested in its world and characters as well.

I'm afraid my age is finally catching up to me - frequently I see old entries in a series and think to myself "oooh that looks interesting", while the latest entry leaves me cold :/ John started the video with a series recap, and Onimusha 2 looks way more inspiring to me than the new one.
